name: bingwacapital.co.ke
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: bingwacapital.co.ke scores 58 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 8 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 14 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /index.php, /About.php, /How%20Bingwa%20Works.php and 4 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /index.php, /About.php, for example .open and button[onclick="location.href='#top';"]. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 2 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /terms-and-conditions answered 404, linked from /, /index.php and 4 more. /privacy-policy answered 404, linked from /, /index.php and 4 more.
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 2 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 6.4.5 (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Swiper/6.4.5/swiper-bundle.min.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2021-23370. Versions of the package swiper before 6.5.1 are susceptible to prototype pollution. jQuery 3.1.0…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 6.5.1 or later; upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or later.

fix.title: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /index.php, /About.php, for example .rights > li:nth-child(2) and .rights > li:nth-child(3). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Put each li inside a ul or ol.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 0.5 s
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
